defmodule CIPipeline.BuildScheduler do
  @moduledoc """
  CI/CD pipeline scheduler with rate limiting and retry logic.
  Queries MongoDB for build configurations and schedules jobs.
  """

  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @max_retries 3
  @rate_limit_window 60_000
  @max_requests_per_window 100

  defstruct [:mongo_conn, :rate_counter, :last_reset, :retry_state]

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(opts) do
    {:ok, conn} = Mongo.start_link(url: opts[:mongo_url], pool_size: 5)
    state = %__MODULE__{
      mongo_conn: conn,
      rate_counter: 0,
      last_reset: System.monotonic_time(:millisecond),
      retry_state: %{}
    }
    {:ok, state}
  end

  def trigger_build(project_id, params) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:trigger_build, project_id, params})
  end

  def get_build_status(query_params) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:get_status, query_params})
  end

  def handle_call({:trigger_build, project_id, params}, _from, state) do
    case check_rate_limit(state) do
      {:ok, new_state} ->
        result = execute_with_retry(fn ->
          schedule_build(new_state.mongo_conn, project_id, params)
        end, @max_retries)
        {:reply, result, new_state}
      {:error, :rate_limited} ->
        {:reply, {:error, :rate_limited}, state}
    end
  end

  def handle_call({:get_status, query_params}, _from, state) do
    case check_rate_limit(state) do
      {:ok, new_state} ->
        result = execute_with_retry(fn ->
          fetch_build_status(new_state.mongo_conn, query_params)
        end, @max_retries)
        {:reply, result, new_state}
      {:error, :rate_limited} ->
        {:reply, {:error, :rate_limited}, state}
    end
  end

  defp check_rate_limit(state) do
    now = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)
    if now - state.last_reset > @rate_limit_window do
      {:ok, %{state | rate_counter: 1, last_reset: now}}
    else
      if state.rate_counter < @max_requests_per_window do
        {:ok, %{state | rate_counter: state.rate_counter + 1}}
      else
        {:error, :rate_limited}
      end
    end
  end

  defp execute_with_retry(fun, retries_left) when retries_left > 0 do
    case fun.() do
      {:ok, result} -> {:ok, result}
      {:error, :timeout} ->
        Process.sleep(exponential_backoff(@max_retries - retries_left))
        execute_with_retry(fun, retries_left - 1)
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp execute_with_retry(_fun, 0), do: {:error, :max_retries_exceeded}

  defp exponential_backoff(attempt) do
    trunc(:math.pow(2, attempt) * 1000) + :rand.uniform(500)
  end

  defp schedule_build(conn, project_id, params) do
    sanitized_id = sanitize_project_id(project_id)
    build_doc = %{
      "project_id" => sanitized_id,
      "status" => "queued",
      "created_at" => DateTime.utc_now(),
      "params" => sanitize_build_params(params)
    }
    case Mongo.insert_one(conn, "builds", build_doc) do
      {:ok, _} -> {:ok, build_doc}
      error -> error
    end
  end

  defp fetch_build_status(conn, query_params) do
    filter = build_status_filter(query_params)
    case Mongo.find(conn, "builds", filter, limit: 50) do
      {:ok, cursor} -> {:ok, Enum.to_list(cursor)}
      error -> error
    end
  end

  defp build_status_filter(params) when is_map(params) do
    params
    |> Enum.reduce(%{}, fn {key, value}, acc ->
      case normalize_filter_key(key) do
        {:ok, normalized_key} ->
          Map.put(acc, normalized_key, coerce_filter_value(normalized_key, value))
        :skip ->
          acc
      end
    end)
  end

  defp normalize_filter_key(key) when is_binary(key) do
    allowed_keys = ["project_id", "status", "created_at", "branch"]
    normalized = String.downcase(String.trim(key))
    if normalized in allowed_keys, do: {:ok, normalized}, else: :skip
  end
  defp normalize_filter_key(_), do: :skip

  defp coerce_filter_value("status", value) when is_binary(value) do
    valid_statuses = ["queued", "running", "success", "failed", "cancelled"]
    if value in valid_statuses, do: value, else: "queued"
  end
  defp coerce_filter_value("created_at", value) when is_map(value) do
    # Allow date range queries with operator maps
    transform_date_operators(value)
  end
  defp coerce_filter_value("project_id", value) when is_binary(value) do
    sanitize_project_id(value)
  end
  defp coerce_filter_value("branch", value) when is_binary(value) do
    if Regex.match?(~r/^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\/\.]+$/, value), do: value, else: "main"
  end
  defp coerce_filter_value(_key, value), do: value

  defp transform_date_operators(date_map) when is_map(date_map) do
    date_map
    |> Enum.reduce(%{}, fn {op, val}, acc ->
      case op do
        "$gte" -> Map.put(acc, "$gte", parse_date_value(val))
        "$lte" -> Map.put(acc, "$lte", parse_date_value(val))
        "$gt" -> Map.put(acc, "$gt", parse_date_value(val))
        "$lt" -> Map.put(acc, "$lt", parse_date_value(val))
        _ -> acc
      end
    end)
  end

  defp parse_date_value(val) when is_binary(val) do
    case DateTime.from_iso8601(val) do
      {:ok, dt, _} -> dt
      _ -> DateTime.utc_now()
    end
  end
  defp parse_date_value(_), do: DateTime.utc_now()

  defp sanitize_project_id(id) when is_binary(id) do
    if Regex.match?(~r/^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+$/, id), do: id, else: raise("Invalid project ID")
  end

  defp sanitize_build_params(params) when is_map(params) do
    allowed = ["branch", "commit_sha", "environment", "tags"]
    params
    |> Enum.filter(fn {k, _v} -> k in allowed end)
    |> Enum.into(%{}, fn {k, v} -> {k, sanitize_param_value(v)} end)
  end

  defp sanitize_param_value(v) when is_binary(v), do: String.slice(v, 0, 255)
  defp sanitize_param_value(v) when is_list(v), do: Enum.map(v, &sanitize_param_value/1)
  defp sanitize_param_value(v) when is_number(v), do: v
  defp sanitize_param_value(_), do: nil
end
